subject: QBR readiness: roadmap exceptions, procurement blockers, and exec asks
messages:
From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: sean_gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Oct 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: QBR readiness: roadmap exceptions, procurement blockers, and exec asks

Team — thanks for joining the sync this morning. Quick written recap so we have a single source of truth heading into QBR prep: 

Summary of open items (short):
- Product exceptions: model-change risk for Siren Analytics (see item #3 in attached playbook).
- Procurement block: SOW redlines stalled on indemnity and data retention clauses. Procurement contact is quoting a 3-week legal review.
- Infra exception: current Dedicated capacity sizing may not meet Siren's 99th percentile latency goal for enterprise tier.

Immediate asks (owners in parentheses):
1) Marissa — lead the customer-facing MAP and push procurement for a one-week review commitment (attachment: MAP_Siren_Analytics.xlsx).
2) Vivek — provide proposed mitigations (quantization/serving split) + ETA for a canary test on dedicated pool (we discussed 2 business days for a feasibility write-up).
3) Karthik — update the QBR playbook with explicit rollback criteria and the exec escalation path (attached: QBR_playbook_v2.pdf).
4) Sean — consolidate all action items into a single heatmap and circulate to execs by EOD Monday.

Risk notes: if procurement extends the legal review >10 business days we will need to present an interim SLO/credit proposal to the customer.

Attachments: QBR_playbook_v2.pdf (pdf), MAP_Siren_Analytics.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks —
Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, sean_gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Oct 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR readiness: roadmap exceptions, procurement blockers, and exec asks

Thanks, Laura — adding procurement context so we can track dependencies.

- Procurement note (from customer): Sarah Lee said legal prefers a mutual indemnity model. Their procurement team can expedite if we accept a narrower retention window for logs (30 days) or offer an audit-only access pattern.
- Ask for Sales: can we provide a short-term concession (one-time onboarding credit) and a fixed statement of work covering the initial 90 days to reduce legal time? I'll own the offer and record it in HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DEAL-4827

Action items I will take:
- Send MAP to Sarah + procurement this afternoon and request a target legal response date (owner: Marissa).
- Draft the one-time onboarding credit proposal and a short SOW that restricts broader data retention to the Dedicated pool only (attachment included).

Attachment: MAP_Siren_Analytics.xlsx

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, sean_gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Oct 2027 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR readiness: roadmap exceptions, procurement blockers, and exec asks

On Wed, 13 Oct 2027 at 11:02, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> - Ask for Sales: can we provide a short-term concession (one-time onboarding credit) and a fixed statement of work covering the initial 90 days to reduce legal time?

Short technical update and proposed mitigations: 
1) Canary test: I can spin up a dedicated canary pool (smaller GPU count) and run Siren's top-10 query mix to validate latency impact. I estimate 48 hours to configure and run (no customer-facing downtime).
2) Split-serving approach: for the initial 90 days we can serve high-sensitivity requests on a quantified low-memory variant and bulk requests on a higher-throughput variant. This reduces infra pressure but requires a short integration change (1 sprint).
3) Fallback plan: If QPS spikes above the threshold, automatic routing to the hosted compatible model (slightly higher token cost) will preserve latency SLOs.

Attachment: infra_runbook.md (note: contains the canary checklist and expected metrics).

I'll follow up with a short feasibility doc by EOD Thursday.

Vivek
Sr. Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, sean_gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 16 Oct 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR readiness: roadmap exceptions, procurement blockers, and exec asks

Thanks for the clear breakdown. Two quick exec notes: 

- Approve a one-time onboarding credit up to $18k (conditional on Sales acceptance and documented ROI assumptions in the MAP). Please capture the credit terms in the SOW draft.
- Request: Sean — include in the heatmap a single prioritized list (priority, owner, ETA) for the items that require exec sign-off (credit, SLA exception, contractual carve-outs). I'll review Monday morning and decide on any additional escalation.

Also specify what metrics we will present to the customer at QBR to demonstrate the risk mitigation (p50/p95 latency, cost delta of split-serving, and rollback triggers).

Aditya Rao
VP, GTM Operations
Redwood Inference

From: sean_gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Oct 2027 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Consolidated QBR action heatmap + next steps (attached)

Team — attached is the consolidated action heatmap per Laura's ask. I pulled together the prioritized items for exec review and added clear owners and ETAs. I also included a short column for "escalation required" to call out anything needing signatures or legal commitments.

Top-line (for Aditya):
- Onboarding credit: Marissa to finalize SOW + credit terms by Wed 10/20 (owner: marissa_cole).
- Canary feasibility: Vivek to deliver canary run results + p50/p95 numbers by Thu 10/21 (owner: vivek_kulkarni).
- Legal redlines: Marissa to request an expedited legal response from Siren procurement; if we do not receive a response by 10/25, trigger the contingency credit offer (owner: marissa_cole).
- Rollback criteria: Karthik to update playbook with explicit triggers and timeline by Fri 10/22 (owner: karthik_iyer).

I've attached the heatmap: QBR_action_heatmap.csv (csv). Please reply with any corrections inline. If no changes, I'll present the heatmap + ask to Aditya on Tue at 10:00am PT.

Related links: playbook + MAP + deal record are in the thread metadata.

Attachments: QBR_action_heatmap.csv

Thanks —
Sean Gallagher
Program Manager, Customer GTM
Redwood Inference
